content:
matt (finance): Quick update: starting 2026-06-01 UTC were switching metering attribution from daily smoothing to minute-level buckets for bursty usage. No price changejust how usage is shown and attributed.

omar (billing): Summary: invoices will include `minute_bucket_ts` on line items. Well still smooth throttling decisions over a 1-hour lookback for rate-limited customers.

sophia (ops): Why: customers saw surprising bills when short spikes were averaged into long periods. Minute attribution gives clearer signals and enables minute-aware routing/fallbacks.

matt (finance): Impact highlights: free credits are consumed at minute granularity (heavy minutes can burn credits faster). Startup promos pre-2025-12-31 get a 90-day roll-forward then sunset; affected customers will receive email.

alyssa (support): Copy for support replies: "We now attribute usage to the minute it occurred; short bursts may appear as spikes in invoices. We can review invoices or enable legacy smoothing temporarily if needed"

omar (billing): Engineering notes: billing events will add `minute_bucket_ts` and `peak_flag`. CSV export fields example: `customer_id,minute_bucket_ts,tokens,route,model,unit_price_usd`.

sophia (ops): Dedicated pools can opt into "minute-aware" fairness. Default behavior preserved for 30 days after launch to give customers time to adapt.

omar (billing): Opt-out: 90-day console/API toggle for legacy daily smoothing. New accounts cant opt in after 2026-08-31; existing opt-ins honored through renewal.

billing-bot: deploy:billing-metering-service v2.14 promoted at 2166001200  minute_bucket_ts enabled.

matt (finance): Rollout plan: public blog + support article 2026-05-05, console banner 2026-05-10, customer emails 2026-05-12, telemetry check 2026-06-08.

omar (billing): Action items: publish CSV spec & FAQ by 2026-04-30; DevEx to add toggle & UI by 2026-05-08; Support to prepare macro/playbook by 2026-05-05.

sophia (ops): Note: invoice export cardinality increases. Data consumers should expect more rows; docs will include partitioning guidance.

matt (finance): For contractual/legal concerns DM me or tag @omar. If invoices look materially different, file in #eng-releases and tag `billing-metering-service` + `priority:high`.

alyssa (support): :thumbsup:

matt (finance): Closing thread  AMA in #announcements-support on 2026-05-15.
